svg.text: ADC1/ADC2/ADC3: 10 DC-coupled inputs; nominal VIN = -2 V ... +2 V
VIN = 2 x (VADC - 1.25 V), nominal. No series coupling capacitor.
Source impedance affects gain/offset. Floating ADC zero detector NOT fitted.
Shared 2.5 V bias: 10 inputs, not VDDA/VREF+
ADC_BIAS_2V5 is shared by all 10 inputs; REF/VDDA remain separate.
